Family filter chips DO show the 179 split correctly. Project Health risk sort red-first verified. iPad layout clean (no page-level horizontal scroll). All other Phase 4C acceptance criteria pass.
rca of the issue: OperationsCenterCommand.jsx line 137 reads `b.specialty_assets_deployed` for the brief tile. Backend brief endpoint computes deployed = assets with project_number set. Preview DB has 179 specialty assets total (sum of family chips 16+88+75+0) but none flagged as deployed, so the brief returns 0. Frontend label says 'Specialty Assets' implying total. Mismatch is either a label or a field selection issue. Mitigation: either (a) component should sum by_family or read a new specialty_assets_total field, or (b) label should read 'Specialty Deployed' to match the deployed metric.
